partner_context.their_ambition: Constance Hotels & Resorts runs a refined Indian-Ocean collection whose Maldivian flagships — Constance Halaveli and Constance Moofushi — are benchmarks of barefoot luxury. Its ambition is an arrival experience as polished as its cellars and cuisine are renowned.
partner_context.their_pressure: At the top of the market, a loud seaplane hop or a rough speedboat is the jarring note in an otherwise flawless stay. For a luxury operator, the transfer is a disproportionate share of guest dissatisfaction relative to its length.
partner_context.where_navier_fits: The N35 makes the arrival itself a luxury moment — enclosed all-weather cabin, level boarding with luggage, silent and smooth — matching Constance's standard from the jetty onward, with zero emissions.

hero.title: Navier × Constance Hotels & Resorts — arrival as a product, across the luxury collection
hero.subtitle: Re-platforming the airport-to-jetty transfer on foiling-electric vessels — silent, all-weather, zero-emission.
hero.what_we_do_together: Navier and Constance Hotels & Resorts bring a foiling-electric arrival layer to its Maldivian islands. Navier supplies the software-defined N35 fleet, captain training and the certification path; Constance Hotels & Resorts brings the resort relationships and the rollout sequence across its luxury collection. The transfer stops being the weakest link in a premium stay and becomes a branded, all-weather, zero-emission arrival — the same calm quality on every island.

why_now: The Navier × JIH Global program — ~100 vessels, $100M, a three-year phased rollout with the first 5 boats in 2026 — proves, publicly and in Maldivian waters, that foiling-electric works at scale. For Constance Hotels & Resorts, that removes the risk: the platform is real and ramping, and the only question is which of its islands to re-platform first.
multimodal_fit: Navier slots between Velana International and the Constance Hotels & Resorts jetty — the highest-value leg of the guest journey — with seaplane retained only for the longest outer-atoll legs. The resort books and brands the experience; guests step from jet to foil to villa.

differentiation.why_navier: The only foiling-electric platform with a live, at-scale national program in the Maldives — software-defined, autonomy-ready, standardised across a fleet, and already proven in service.

proof_points.claim: Foiling-electric is already deploying at national scale in the Maldives.
proof_points.evidence: Navier × JIH Global: ~100 vessels / $100M / three-year phasing; first 5 boats in 2026.

proof_points.claim: The platform is proven in service.
proof_points.evidence: 10 vessels delivered, 4,000+ flight hours, 2025 production sold out.

proof_points.claim: The arrival experience is a premium differentiator.
proof_points.evidence: Nearly every Maldivian guest requires a sea or air transfer on arrival; making it smooth, quiet and reliable directly lifts guest satisfaction.

proof_points.claim: The arrival is the single biggest friction in a Maldives stay — and the easiest to upgrade.
proof_points.evidence: Today guests trade a long-haul flight for a daylight-only seaplane or a swell-prone speedboat. A foiling-electric transfer is faster, smoother, quieter and weather-resilient — converting the most-complained-about part of the journey into a signature, on-brand moment.

objections.concern: Can it handle open-atoll crossings and swell?
objections.response: The foil flies above the chop for a smoother ride than a diesel speedboat in the same conditions; the N35's enclosed all-weather cabin keeps arrivals comfortable and on-schedule, and the Quanta-LR hybrid covers the longest crossings with no charging infrastructure.

objections.concern: What about charging across remote islands?
objections.response: The N35 needs only a berth pedestal at the resort jetty; the Quanta-LR hybrid needs no charging at all — so coverage is not gated on building charging at every island.

objections.concern: Won't guests still depend on seaplanes for the outer atolls?
objections.response: That's the point. Maldivian seaplanes fly in daylight only, so late-arriving guests lose a night to an airport hotel. A Quanta-LR foiling vessel reaches the outer atolls — up to 700 nm of hybrid range — and arrives smoothly after dark, turning a forced overnight into a same-night welcome.

the_ask.partner_brings: Resort relationships across its luxury collection, the island-by-island rollout sequence, jetty access and the guest-experience standard.

close.title: The arrival, finally as good as the stay.
close.body: For Constance Hotels & Resorts, the transfer has always been the one part of the journey that didn't match the islands. Foiling-electric closes that gap — a silent, all-weather, zero-emission arrival, the same quality on every island.

why_navier_now.step_change: Hydrofoiling lifts the hull clear of the water, so a Navier vessel flies instead of plowing through chop — roughly 10x more efficient than a conventional planing boat, faster (30+ kt cruise), and dramatically smoother and quieter. Software-defined and autonomy-ready, the same fleet keeps improving over time.
why_navier_now.no_new_infrastructure: Navier rides on infrastructure that already exists — the open ocean and the resort jetties already in use. No vertiports, no new rights-of-way. The N35 needs only a berth pedestal; the Quanta-LR hybrid needs no charging infrastructure at all.
why_navier_now.the_moment: Decarbonization expectations turned diesel transfer fleets into a liability, the platform crossed from prototype to proven service, and a national-scale Maldives program is already live — the resort arrival layer is being re-platformed right now.

revenue_potential.headline: The floor and the prize — every rung traces to grounded, sourced demand.
revenue_potential.modal_lead: We start from grounded corridor demand. Each step adds one realistic expansion lever — network width, induced demand, journey wallet, platform take.
revenue_potential.anchor_note: $4M/yr premium sea-transfer spend on sourced corridors today — the anchor every rung builds from.

whose_money_legend.navier_transport_revenue: Fare the Navier boats collect. This is the corridor P&L (atom.py). SOM/SAM rungs are in this unit.
whose_money_legend.journey_gmv: Total spend on the whole island journey flowing through the super-app: transport + food + stays + experiences + ads + parcel/logistics. Gross, all merchants. TAM rung is in this unit.
whose_money_legend.platform_take: The partner's (Grab's) own commission revenue on journey_gmv. Derived line — this is the number that makes a super-app care, not the boat fare.
